reason: sha256:c34f158b9d3a6703006094fc0ac3f50bdf8a8f96665ec161ac5398958f51186e: the recorded verification for this pass is host-refusal (kind 'host-refusal'), not a checker pass: 'Assembly refused unaccepted dependencies; verification unavailable. Inspect preserved child results.' The only preserved child (result_ref c0001, template evidence_read, status 'unaccepted', output_status 'partial') contains a complete C1-C8 analysis with every required label (INPUT_QUOTE, CANDIDATE_MEANINGS with EVIDENCE_LINES and WOULD_SETTLE, WORKING_READING, CONFIDENCE_AND_ALTERNATIVES, CONFORMANCE_BEFORE_ACTION, PROHIBITED_PRECONFIRMATION_ACTION) plus RUN_CONTROL, and its quotes carry byte locators against UC3-cases. So there is usable partial content but no determination that the eight analyses meet the source-grounding obligations, and two defects in the partial output itself warrant a changed pass rather than acceptance: (1) quotes were validated only by the child's own self-report, never by a host read of UC3-cases, so the byte locators (e.g. C1 bytes:224:291 through C8 bytes:999:1061) are unconfirmed; (2) the child's RUN_CONTROL is explicitly a provisional pre-verification proposal and asserts 'No earlier control decisions are available to quote', which must be resolved against the actual control record. A further pass is useful because the needed change is concrete: re-run the same evidence_read analysis of UC3-cases under a dependency set that the host will accept (the prior assembly refusal was about unaccepted dependencies, not about the task text), so a fresh child result can be assembled and then host-verified against the eight quotes and required labels; only after that verification may the pilot control consider a substantive stop. This decision does not treat the refusal as task exhaustion and does not claim any check passed.
what_changes_next: Re-issue the UC3-cases intent-reading/conformance pass (template evidence_read, source_refs ['UC3-cases']) as a fresh dependency the assembler can accept, preserving the exact eight INPUT_QUOTE bytes and the required label set; require the child to restate each byte locator so the host can confirm or correct the spans 224:291, 323:380, 422:494, 538:604, 643:726, 767:836, 894:960, 999:1061, and to explicitly state whether any prior continue_or_stop control decision exists. No edits to the analysis content itself; no other template or subtask input changes until this verified result exists.
stop_rule: Stop only when host verification for a pass confirms all eight analyses C1-C8 carry the required labels and are source-grounded to UC3-cases (each INPUT_QUOTE and EVIDENCE_LINE resolvable to the sealed document), the run is otherwise complete, and the pilot continue_or_stop control records that verification reference with this reason; OR a recorded guard stops the run (max_calls 300 logical calls or the owner-required max_spend_usd 6.0 default, remaining_calls 297 / remaining_usd 5.987931924 at this decision) — a call/spend ceiling stop is a host resource stop and partial, not task exhaustion; other instrument failures (such as this pass's host-refusal verification) remain separately identified failures and likewise do not by themselves mean task exhaustion.
